metrics.name: Contract awards
metrics.description: Number of signed contract awards (DS00005 contracts, FY2020+). A contract, not a notice.

metrics.name: Contract-award announcement notices
metrics.description: Number of published Contract Award notices (award records in DS00979). A notice, not a contract; links to contracts exist only for 184 projects.
caveats: Award announcements are published after signing (median 157 days) and are not contracts.

metrics.name: Contract award value (US$)
metrics.description: Exact sum of contract amounts at contract grain (sum of published supplier lines). Covers all financiers of each contract.
caveats: Not an IBRD/IDA amount; never added to financing commitments.

metrics.name: IBRD/IDA original principal (US$ as published)
metrics.description: Sum of original principal of IBRD loans and IDA credits, per lender.
metrics.grain_note: sum at instrument grain, per lender
caveats: US$ equivalents are not on one consistent exchange-rate basis.
metrics.source: SILVER_RELATIONSHIP_REPORT.md (sum original_principal_amount_usd per lender; never mix with contract amounts)

metrics.name: Project current total commitment (US$ snapshot)
metrics.description: Current total commitment of projects as of the 2026-10-21 projects snapshot.
caveats: Current, not original; differs from IBRD/IDA principal for 472 of 1,597 projects.

metrics.name: Procurement notices
metrics.description: Number of published procurement notices of all classes.
metrics.grain_note: notice grain (identical-metadata rows counted as published)

metrics.name: Tender invitation notices (IFB)
metrics.description: Number of Invitation for Bids notices (actual tender notices).
caveats: A tender notice is not a contract; not every tender can be linked to a signed contract.

metrics.name: Solicitation notices (IFB, IFP, REOI)
metrics.description: Number of notices with a response deadline: Invitation for Bids, Invitation for Prequalification and Request for Expression of Interest.

metrics.name: Prior-review share of contracts
metrics.description: prior_review_contracts / (prior_review_contracts + post_review_contracts); contracts with unknown review type are excluded.
metrics.grain_note: computed at display time from additive counts

metrics.name: Share of contracts with other-country suppliers
metrics.grain_note: computed at display time from additive counts

metrics.name: Median published response window (days)
metrics.description: Discrete median of published response windows (1-180 days) for eligible solicitations.
metrics.grain_note: one grouping_level at a time; not additive
caveats: Published windows, NOT verified tender durations.

metrics.name: IBRD/IDA financing instruments
metrics.description: Number of IBRD loans and IDA credits/grants, by lender.

metrics.name: Contracts with an evidence-supported award-notice link
metrics.description: Contracts whose award_notice_link_status is unambiguous or ambiguous, among covered contracts.
caveats: Links exist only for the 184 API-covered projects; no_link_found does not prove there is no notice.

examples.question: Show the portfolio record for a project
examples.sql_text: SELECT project_id, project_name, region_name, source_country_name, approval_fiscal_year, project_status_snapshot, contract_award_count, contract_award_amount_usd, notice_count, ibrd_loan_count, ida_credit_count FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_project_portfolio WHERE project_id = :project_id LIMIT 10
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: Show a contract award by its World Bank contract number
examples.sql_text: SELECT wb_contract_number, project_id, project_name, procurement_category, procurement_method, review_type, contract_signing_date, contract_fiscal_year, contract_amount_usd, award_notice_link_status FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics WHERE wb_contract_number = :wb_contract_number LIMIT 10
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: How many contract awards and what award value does each project in a country have?
examples.sql_text: SELECT project_id, count(*) AS contract_awards, sum(contract_amount_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics WHERE wdi_country_code = :country_code GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY contract_awards DESC LIMIT 100
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: What is the contract award value by procurement method?
examples.sql_text: SELECT procurement_method, sum(contract_awards) AS contract_awards, sum(contract_award_value_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd FROM workspace.wbg_gold.vw_kpi_contract_awards GROUP BY procurement_method ORDER BY contract_award_value_usd DESC LIMIT 100
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: How many contracts were awarded, and for what value, in a country in a fiscal year?
examples.sql_text: SELECT contract_fiscal_year, wdi_country_code, sum(contract_awards) AS contract_awards, sum(contract_award_value_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd FROM workspace.wbg_gold.vw_kpi_contract_awards WHERE wdi_country_code = :country_code AND contract_fiscal_year = :fiscal_year GROUP BY contract_fiscal_year, wdi_country_code LIMIT 10
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: How many tender invitation notices were published per procurement category?
examples.sql_text: SELECT procurement_category, count(*) AS tender_invitation_notices FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_procurement_notices WHERE is_tender_invitation GROUP BY procurement_category ORDER BY tender_invitation_notices DESC LIMIT 20
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: What contract award value went to projects by IEG outcome rating?
examples.sql_text: SELECT p.ieg_outcome_rating, count(*) AS contract_awards, sum(c.contract_amount_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics AS c JOIN workspace.wbg_gold.gold_project_portfolio AS p ON c.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY p.ieg_outcome_rating ORDER BY contract_award_value_usd DESC LIMIT 20
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: What is the contract award value of projects that have IDA financing?
examples.sql_text: WITH ida_projects AS (SELECT project_id, count(*) AS ida_instruments FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_financing_analytics WHERE lender = :lender GROUP BY project_id) SELECT count(DISTINCT c.project_id) AS projects, count(*) AS contract_awards, sum(c.contract_amount_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics AS c JOIN ida_projects AS f ON c.project_id = f.project_id LIMIT 10
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: How many invitations for bids were published in a fiscal year?
examples.sql_text: SELECT publication_fiscal_year, sum(procurement_notices) AS tender_invitation_notices FROM workspace.wbg_gold.vw_kpi_notice_activity WHERE notice_class = 'tender_invitation' AND publication_fiscal_year = :fiscal_year GROUP BY publication_fiscal_year LIMIT 10
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: For each country, what are the contract awards, award value and tender invitations, top countries by award value?
examples.sql_text: WITH contracts AS (SELECT wdi_country_code, count(*) AS contract_awards, sum(contract_amount_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics WHERE geography_type = 'single_country' GROUP BY wdi_country_code), tenders AS (SELECT wdi_country_code, count_if(is_tender_invitation) AS tender_invitation_notices FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_procurement_notices WHERE geography_type = 'single_country' GROUP BY wdi_country_code) SELECT c.wdi_country_code, c.contract_awards, c.contract_award_value_usd, coalesce(t.tender_invitation_notices, 0) AS tender_invitation_notices FROM contracts AS c LEFT JOIN tenders AS t ON c.wdi_country_code = t.wdi_country_code ORDER BY c.contract_award_value_usd DESC LIMIT 10
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: What is the median published response window by notice type?
examples.sql_text: SELECT notice_type, eligible_solicitation_notices, positive_window_notices, p50_window_days FROM workspace.wbg_gold.vw_kpi_response_windows WHERE grouping_level = 'type' ORDER BY notice_type LIMIT 20
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.

examples.question: What are the headline procurement totals?
examples.sql_text: SELECT total_projects, contract_awards, total_contract_award_value_usd, procurement_notices, tender_invitation_notices, contract_award_announcement_notices, ibrd_loan_instruments, ida_credit_instruments FROM workspace.wbg_gold.vw_kpi_overview LIMIT 1
examples.verification_note: Reviewed template; not yet verified against a baseline.
